title: Audit THREE-base supplier billing from native events (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Closes the finite supplier-census handoff in [#4426](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4426). That p7 controller audit inherited the THREE-base supplier receipt. This package independently derives its paid histogram from the literal native events and nine-bit frame bases, without importing or executing a predecessor interpreter.

Both orientations reproduce the unsplit profile **{1:2487, 2:713, 3:224, 4:102, 5:20, 8:8}**: **3,554 paid calls, rank mass 5,157**. All **408** nested helper increments reproduce **{5:28, 6:18, 7:56, 8:93, 9:213}**, rank mass **3,301**. Gaussian elimination derives dimensions and containment rather than trusting declared ranks.

The stored native certificate contains sixteen split center events. The audit checks eight adjacent 8→3→0 / 0→3→8 chains and reconstructs the unsplit centers by an explicit common-frame telescoping argument. It then rechecks the coalesced programs and compares complete distributions, event counts and rank masses to #4426's exact supplier receipt. A phase-by-phase census and the actual center locations are retained in RESULT.json.

**Claim type: finite accounting audit; no new κ.** Operator equality, absolute Clifford phases, physical normalization/admission, scalar primitive pricing, the p7 controller, compiler/tensor, precision/stock and outer/analytic obligations remain inherited. A deliberate in-memory ADD sign flip preserves the census, explicitly demonstrating the operator-identity coverage boundary. No selected record or predecessor source is changed.

## Task and overlap

- Refined `independent-moment` card, priority revision 7; handoff-first selection.
- Started from canonical main **2a13eb1827784206202db90e5dc8327cf8a250db**; main, guidance and inputs remained unchanged at the submission refresh.
- Canonical coordination: [Discussion #4445](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4445), linked from the [#4426 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19109077).
- Final helper coverage: all 5,731 tracked local note/ledger paths, 303 open PR bodies and 3,294 Discussion records, complete pagination at 21:16/21:17 UTC. No competing census found; this does not establish novelty. Closed PRs were covered through retained notes/ledger, not every closed body or code diff.
- #4426 supplies the controller reconstruction; #4420/#4428 cover arithmetic. #4441 changes the helper word and is outside this frozen audit. The older t360 local-rewrite census searches different predecessor words.

Only `research/three-base-paid-census/` is added. Exact Git blobs, SHA256 pins, provenance, task scope and bounded replay are included. All three live inputs are already on main.

## Validation

Local Windows / CPython 3.12.0, standard library only; each scientific run took approximately 9 seconds:

```text
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/three-base-paid-census --check-only
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)

python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/three-base-paid-census
PASS_THREE_BASE_PAID_CENSUS orientations=2 controls=16
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/three-base-paid-census outcome=completed

python -O -B research/three-base-paid-census/verify.py
PASS_THREE_BASE_PAID_CENSUS orientations=2 controls=16

python -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/three-base-paid-census
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

The **16 rejection controls** cover source corruption/misbinding, declared rank, deleted paid work, nonnested equal-dimension frames, stale warp/scalar frames, borrowed clearing, broken center pairs, dependent bases, final frames, unknown events, rank-mass-preserving invoice changes and a count-and-mass-preserving helper change. All 512 ordered triples in F2^3 cross-check the elimination algorithm against enumerated spans.

The baseline orientation command was attempted but failed on an omitted source-closure directory in this sparse checkout; it is not claimed as passing. All targeted inputs were materialized and authenticated. No complete selected cold replay, hosted CI result, independent human review or formal proof is claimed here. Byte preflight passed for all nine package/input files at **e8305f07db188d6fa0be1c91ae77cc2414ea029d**.

Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337: #4416 at `e9058860b5c850760fdf970e796a96aefcdb1d98`, the p7 construction. zxv: #4359's source closure at `da637c87c89482bc4c86be36bd0071b3d400dbed`, the full-identity supplier and center split. The package links the checkpoint's full native/frame and mixed-recursion contributor map.

Prepared for **mihir-s-05 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; frozen sources and notices retained. No subagents.

## Open next questions

No further census of these exact bytes is justified by the matching result. The package's **Open next questions** section separates the completed finite handoff from inherited physical/operator and downstream evidence; their absence from this audit is not a claim that the repository lacks them. A changed word requires its own source-bound audit.
